page.layout: Printed page with a running head and page number at the top. Main text in one wide column. A large centred title block (Latin heading, subtitle, and the opening of the decree) sits in the lower half of the text column. Marginal notes run down the left margin, in several short blocks, beside the title and the first lines of the decree. Scan is heavily stained; many lines are unreadable.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~40 letters] Quin & Academiis in Prugmiensi [illegible, ~60 letters] Dei gratia [illegible, ~80 letters] Bohemiae [illegible, ~120 letters] imperii [illegible, ~100 letters].
8. Mandamus igitur omnibus cum integro justitiae in Bohemia consistentibus, ut [illegible, ~150 letters] Julij. Anno 1612.
main_text.head: MATTHIÆ IMPERATORIS AUGUSTI MANDATUM
De tollendo novo vectigali, atque intermittenda ac denuo [illegible, ~10 letters] ad Hebraeum.
main_text.p: NOS Matthias Dei gratia, Electus Romanorum Imperator Semper Augustus, Hungariae, Bohemiae, Dalmatiae, Croatiae, Sclavoniae, etc. Rex: [illegible, ~250 letters] Illustribus Fidelibus Marchionum [illegible, ~300 letters] Palatinis ad Rhenum, Duces Bavariae, Comites Valdensis & Aposto[illegible, ~150 letters] Cancellarius, Mathias Peurion, Christianus, Simeon, Joannes, Henricus, Nicolaus, Georgius, Johannes, Franciscus, Carolus, Matthaeus, Johannes [illegible, ~200 letters].
{a} Omittit Borussiam, propter jus Magistri Theutonicorum in eam provinciam ab Imperio alienatam.
{c} Ca[illegible, ~5 letters] non ad [illegible, ~10 letters] Joannitarum per Marchiam, Saxoniam, Pomeraniam & Vandaliam Ordine Magistro [illegible, ~20 letters].

page.notes: Left margin notes beside the title and first lines of the decree: "Anno Christi 1612", "Interprete Caluino Eps.", and the lettered notes a, b, c as transcribed above. Much of the body text, the top paragraphs and the decree lines are too faded to read; they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The subtitle and some names are doubtful.
